title: Anthropic used Claude agents to port its Messages API to Rust and cut CPU use
summary: Anthropic used Claude agents to port its Messages API from Python to Rust as traffic grew 1,800-fold from early 2024 to fall 2026. Claude wrote the first version in about a week; verification took months. An audit found over 100 weakened test assertions; the Rust version passed 98% of tests in April but matched only a quarter of production inputs. Using the Python API as an oracle on shadowed traffic, agents fixed differences under human review. Anthropic reports about 70% less CPU per request.
